Why Cloud-Host Your TallyPrime?

On-premise TallyPrime limits your team to one location. Cloud hosting removes that constraint — permanently.

Access from Anywhere

Open TallyPrime on any device — laptop, tablet, or phone — from your office, home, or while travelling across Kenya.

99.9% Uptime SLA

Our cloud infrastructure is hosted on enterprise-grade servers with redundant connectivity and daily automated backups.

Bank-Grade Security

All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Role-based access control ensures each user sees only what they need to.

Dedicated Tally Server

Your TallyPrime runs on a dedicated virtual machine — not shared with other businesses. Your data is always yours.

Multi-User Collaboration

Your entire team works on the same live data simultaneously — accounts, inventory, and payroll all in sync.

Remote Support Ready

Our support team can connect to your cloud instance instantly to resolve issues without waiting for an on-site visit.

Cloud Hosting FAQs

Do I still need to buy a TallyPrime licence for cloud hosting?

Yes. Cloud hosting is a separate service from the TallyPrime licence. You need a valid TallyPrime Gold licence to use multi-user cloud hosting. We can bundle both into a single package.

How do users access TallyPrime on the cloud?

Users connect via a secure remote desktop connection (RDP) or browser-based client. We set up each user's device in under 30 minutes. No technical knowledge required from your team.

What happens to my data if I stop the subscription?

We provide a full data export in TallyPrime backup format before decommissioning your instance. Your data is always yours.

Is my data backed up?

Yes. All plans include daily automated backups retained for 30 days. Enterprise plans include hourly backups. Restore requests are handled within 2 hours.
